summary: Strong keystone B1.2 pair. Single-strategy decomposition trap (rigid '30+2 every time') is a real Grade-1 misconception with branching recovery via rod manipulation. Materials everyday with no-puppet fallback and movement variant. Otto/Lila/Scoot anchor consistently; 'I can' success criteria; vocab child-friendly. Worksheet Parts 1-3 mirror the lesson while varying format (Part 3 is open transfer). Children invent and compare strategies; decomposition flexibility named as the B1.2 mastery signal.
